summary: This bill designates the United States Postal Service facility located at 514 Frelinghuysen Avenue in Newark, New Jersey, as the "Mildred Joyce Coleman Crump Post Office Building."

scores.thoughts: This bill is solely about renaming a post office. It does not involve any new appropriations, changes to existing spending, or any financial implications for the government. Therefore, it has no bearing on government spending.
The bill renames a post office and has no provisions related to voting access, election reform, voter ID, or election security. It is entirely unrelated to voting and elections.
